title: The Masked People and the Baby
surface: Masked people gather around a woman. One holds a blade. Soon they carry her child away. Her partner watches without intervening; afterward the couple pays these people and thanks them. Why?
solution: She is undergoing a cesarean birth she consented to. The masked people are medical staff and the blade is a surgical instrument. They carry the newborn aside for checks and care, then return the baby to the family. Her partner is there for support, and the payment is a medical bill.

facts.text: This is a consensual cesarean birth performed by masked medical staff.
The newborn is taken for routine care and checks, not kidnapped.
The baby is returned to the family; the partner is present for support and the payment is a medical fee.

unknowns: The hospital, fee and procedural details are unspecified.
hints: Masks and blades can be ordinary professional equipment.
Where was the child before the scene began?
A new baby is being delivered by surgery.
